title: [Salty's Services, Walls]
description: The area is spare, with its most prominent feature being a wide wooden bench carved with twin starfish set in the room's middle over a threadbare carpet.  This bench offers a view of the area walls, which are an amalgamation of style and material, mirroring the options for sale here as individual segments of wall.  Simple votives are set alongside the bench and are also interspersed throughout the room, allowing for better viewing of the varying types of wall patterns the warehouse offers to prospective merchants.
